request.title: Secret requested
request.intro: The a4all agent needs a secret. It goes straight to your private credential store over HTTPS and never into the chat; the agent only sees its name.
request.cardBody: {label} — the agent is paused until you enter or decline it.
request.name: Saved as
request.expired: This request has expired. Ask the agent again if you still want to share it.
request.submitted: Secret {name} sent securely. The agent only sees its name.

save.title: Share a secret securely
save.intro: Paste a password, token or key here instead of the chat. It is saved to your private credential store and the message gets a reference to it, like {ref}.
save.name: Name
save.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (up to 64).
save.nameInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, starting with a letter or digit.
save.saved: Saved {name}. A reference was added to your message.

error.gone: This request is no longer open.
error.forbidden: This request belongs to someone else.
error.answered: This request was already answered or has expired.
error.invalid: That was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
error.failed: That didn't go through. Try again.

composer.detected: This looks like a secret ({kind}). Secrets in chat text are stored in the transcript and sent to the model.
